messages:
Mira: anyone else seeing a spike of failed inference requests in ap-south1? dashboards show 5xxs and pods stuck Pending. autoscaler isn't adding GPUs.
Ashok: I see it — metrics show a massive burst from customer X. autoscaler signal spiked but node creation failing repeatedly.
devops-bot: [ALERT] ap-south1-gpu-pool: 75% pod evictions, 18 Pending, 12 FailedProvisioning.
Mira: paste of the controller logs:
infra-ci: ```
E0303 12:03:45.123 controller.go:412] provisioner: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: "gpu-vms-per-region quota exceeded"
E0303 12:03:47.987 k8s: Error attaching CNI: timeout waiting for network interface
```
Kai: Looks like two separate failure modes: cloud quota limits and intermittent CNI attach timeouts. CNI failures are causing nodes to be NotReady and triggering evictions -> autoscaler oscillation.
Ashok: Confirmed. Cloud API shows quota rps spike from several automated onboarding jobs plus the customer burst. QuotaErrors are returning 409/429.
Olivia: I'm filing an incident and notifying oncall. We should consider failover routing before more customers get impacted.
Mira: Is there a quick mitigation? Can we toggle fallback routing to eu-west1 for that customer? There will be egress/cost impact.
Kai: We can route new sessions to eu-west1 but stateful caches won't be warm. Latency will increase ~120ms, and cross-region egress estimate ~ $4.5k/hr at current throughput.
Ashok: I'm starting a manual node pool with preemptible GPUs in ap-south1 to bypass the autoscaler path. Template uses a lower CNI concurrency and retries. This should come up in ~6-8m if quota allows. If quota blocks, we need a contact with cloud support.
Mira: manual pool command I ran: ``gcloud compute instances create-with-container gpu-preempt-01 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --zone=ap-south1-a --container-image=redwood/inference:prod``
devops-bot: New nodepool creation: started (operation id op-3421).
Ashok: Node creation started but now failing with: ``ERROR: insufficient regional GPUs available`` — capacity shortfall rather than quota.
Kai: Great, so two constraints: regional capacity exhaustion + transient CNI attach timeouts that amplify evictions. Autoscaler keeps seeing Pending so it keeps requesting nodes -> request flood -> throttled API -> thrash.
Olivia: Action items: 1) Open cloud capacity request (Ashok). 2) Enable customer-level failover to eu-west1 (Mira). 3) Increase eviction TTLs and tolerate NotReady for longer to avoid churn (Kai). 4) Run targeted scaling down of non-critical batch jobs (Mira/Kai). 5) Postmortem owner? (Olivia).
Ashok: I've opened a capacity ticket and pinged partner rep (ticket# 87632). Also scaling down non-critical jobs: running `kubectl scale --namespace=batch deploy/large-batch -–replicas=1`.
Mira: I'm flipping the routing rule for customer X to eu-west1 now (manual override). Monitor shows traffic shifting; 5xxs drop from 18% -> 2% within 90s.
devops-bot: Router update complete: traffic for customer X now routed to eu-west1.
Kai: Making a temporary change to kube-controller manager: set node-monitor-grace-period to 40s and pod-eviction-timeout to 5m to reduce eviction thrash. Pushing change to canary first.
Mira: Good call. Also let's add a short-term autoscaler debounce: increase scale-up stabilization window to 90s so we don't spam requests during the quota/CNI flapping.
Olivia: Incident created: INC-2026-032-ap-south1-capacity. Notifying APAC account execs and finance for potential egress spend.
Ashok: Cloud rep replied: "regional GPU capacity low for next 2 hours, recommend cross-region failover or reserved capacity". They've bumped quota but can't allocate physical GPUs.
Kai: We'll keep eu-west failover until capacity stabilizes. I'll follow up with a postmortem on CNI attach failure correlation with kernel upgrade we rolled last week.
Mira: TL;DR — root causes: regional GPU capacity exhaustion + CNI attach timeouts causing node NotReady -> eviction thrash -> autoscaler noise. Mitigations: manual failover, longer eviction thresholds, scale down batch jobs, open capacity ticket, adjust autoscaler debounce.
Olivia: Thanks all. I'll run the incident timeline and assign postmortem. Please paste any logs/errors into the incident doc. :thumbsup:
